fact: BCPFS and ONECI signed a convention on 2 April 2026 interconnecting the Registre Social Unique with ONECI's databases, with beneficiaries identified through the national register of persons to remove duplicates.
The Bureau de Coordination des Programmes Filets Sociaux says the RSU, set up in 2019, has more than 1.45 million households and 8.8 million individuals registered.
BCP Filets Sociaux says more than 200,000 households were in the process of registration in the RSU, managed through the SIG-RSU system, as of April 2025.
